project.title: Effects of Simulated Colloidal Components of Neutral Purple Soil on Methane Production and Microbial Community During Anaerobic Digestion of Food Waste
project.description: This project investigates how simulated colloidal components of neutral purple soil influence methane production and microbial community structure during anaerobic digestion of food waste. The dataset includes bacterial and archaeal 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data obtained from batch anaerobic digestion experiments. Treatments involving montmorillonite, quartz, Ca/Na feldspar, and their binary combinations were investigated to evaluate their effects on volatile fatty acid conversion, microbial community composition, and methanogenic potential. The montmorillonite and quartz combination exhibited the highest methane yield, accompanied by enrichment of Methanosarcina and norank_c__Clostridia and increased predicted functional potential associated with CO2-reducing methanogenesis.
